notifications.body: Root: #574 is assigned to you with #572, because it is the same class. A provider crash ends the seat because of three defaults: memberRetryAttempts null (durable retry off), TRANSIENT_TURN_RETRY_LIMIT = 1 (a hardcoded count), and rerouteOnProviderFault 'manual' (a proposed reroute waits for an orchestrator). The operator wants a crash to be recoverable by default: durable retry in place, then an automatic reroute, with the orchestrator woken with a report rather than having to act. Reroute candidates must exclude codex/* routes.

Policy corrections are agreed. Please commit and publish your current verified wave change now so I can compose and run union gates. Both concern the 300 000 ms STEERING NUDGE WINDOW that #572 deliberately removed - _progressNudgeWindowMs has zero references in impl/src at this tip. Neither lane alone shows it: the limits lane was green because the window still existed there, and #572's files never touch this one, so the composition is the only place it appears.
